body.value: 權大參事　五人
権大参事（ごんだいさんじ）五人

Provisional senior councillors (gon-dai-sanji): five men. This column lies to the RIGHT of the ○水口藩 marker, so it belongs to the preceding domain, Miyazu (宮津藩), whose block opened on the facing leaf. No names are printed for Miyazu's officials — only headcounts.
宮津權大參事
少參事　四人
少参事（しょうさんじ）四人
Junior councillors (shō-sanji): four men. Right of the ○水口藩 marker, so it belongs to Miyazu (宮津藩), not Minakuchi.
宮津少參事
權少參事　四人
権少参事（ごんしょうさんじ）四人

Provisional junior councillors (gon-shō-sanji): four men. Right of the ○水口藩 marker, so it belongs to Miyazu (宮津藩). With the 大參事 one man recorded on the facing leaf, Miyazu's councillor establishment totals fourteen.
宮津權少參事
兵隊　四百四十九人　士族
兵隊（へいたい）四百四十九人　士族（しぞく）

Troops: 449 men of shizoku (former samurai) status. The label 兵隊 heads this column and governs both halves of the split; the sotsu half prints as a separate run to the left. Right of the ○水口藩 marker, so it belongs to Miyazu (宮津藩). Against Miyazu's fascicle-7 shizoku population of 2,298 persons, these 449 soldiers are 19.5 percent.
宮津兵隊士族
二百三十九人　卒
二百三十九人　卒（そつ）

Troops: 239 men of sotsu (lower retainer) status — the left half of the 兵隊 split, the shizoku half standing to its right. Right of the ○水口藩 marker, so it belongs to Miyazu (宮津藩). The two halves sum to 688 troops; the source prints no total. MASTER's fascicle-7 row for 宮津藩 records 兵隊 二百三十九人, i.e. this sotsu figure alone.
宮津兵隊卒
○水口藩
○水口藩（みなくちはん）

The domain boundary marker opening Minakuchi (水口藩), a 25,000-koku domain of the Katō house in Ōmi province. Everything to the left of this circle is Minakuchi; everything to the right belongs to the preceding domain, Miyazu (宮津藩).
水口藩丸印
大參事　一人　中村栗翁
大参事（だいさんじ）一人 — 中村栗翁（なかむら りつおう）
Senior councillor (dai-sanji) of Minakuchi: one man, Nakamura Ritsuō. First column left of the ○水口藩 marker.
水口大參事
權大參事　二人　加藤精一　岡田正和
権大参事（ごんだいさんじ）二人 — 加藤精一（かとう せいいち）・岡田正和（おかだ まさかず）

Provisional senior councillors (gon-dai-sanji) of Minakuchi: two men, Katō Seiichi and Okada Masakazu, printed as two four-slot name blocks in the same column. The printed count of two matches the two names. Katō is the surname of the ruling house of Minakuchi.
水口權大參事
少參事　二人　佃　極
少参事（しょうさんじ）二人 — 佃極（つくだ きわむ）

Junior councillors (shō-sanji) of Minakuchi: two men, but only one name is printed — Tsukuda Kiwamu, set in slots one and four of a four-slot name block (the layout used for a one-glyph surname with a one-glyph given name). The second name is absent from the leaf. Two small marks are printed beside this column's numeral; they are boxed separately.
水口少參事
〔傍點二點〕
少参事欄の数字「二」の右傍に打たれた小さな二点（傍点）

Two small marks — a wedge above a dot — printed immediately to the right of the numeral 二 in the 少參事 column. They are crisp, type-weight ink and are the only such marks on the leaf, so they are printed matter rather than a blemish; their editorial meaning cannot be established from this page alone. They stand beside the one place on the leaf where the count and the names disagree: 少參事 gives a count of two with one name, while the 權少參事 column to its left gives two names with no count.
少參事欄傍點
權少參事　井碕與山　今村　昇
権少参事（ごんしょうさんじ）— 井碕與山（いさき よざん）・今村昇（いまむら のぼる）

Provisional junior councillors (gon-shō-sanji) of Minakuchi: two names are printed, Isaki Yozan and Imamura Noboru, but NO headcount appears — the slot every other office column on this leaf uses for its 「N人」 figure is blank here. Recorded as printed; the count is supplied by neither this leaf nor its neighbour.
水口權少參事
鬪虎隊　一小隊五十人
闘虎隊（とうこたい）一小隊五十人

The Tōko-tai ("Fighting Tiger corps") of Minakuchi: one company (shōtai) of fifty men. With the Kanshi-tai below it, this is one of the two fifty-man companies that MASTER's fascicle-7 entry for 水口藩 records anonymously as 二小隊 一小隊五十人.
水口鬪虎隊
敢死隊　一小隊五十人
敢死隊（かんしたい）一小隊五十人

The Kanshi-tai ("Dare-to-Die corps") of Minakuchi: one company (shōtai) of fifty men. Together with the Tōko-tai this gives Minakuchi 100 infantry in two companies, matching the domain's fascicle-7 return exactly.
水口敢死隊
礮隊　一分隊二十四人
礮隊（＝砲隊、ほうたい）一分隊二十四人

Artillery corps of Minakuchi: one section (buntai) of twenty-four men. 礮 is the older form of 砲 (cannon), verified glyph by glyph. MASTER's fascicle-7 row for 水口藩 records 砲隊 二十四人, the same twenty-four men under the modern character.
水口礮隊
藩制一覽表第九（水口）
藩制一覧表 第九冊（水口藩）— 欄外の柱書き

Running header in the outer margin: Domain Survey (Hansei Ichiran), ninth fascicle, Minakuchi section. This is a provenance label, not data. It names Minakuchi, the domain whose block opens on this leaf at the ○水口藩 marker.
柱書藩制一覧表第九水口
四百四十五
四百四十五（丁数）

The printed book-page number in the outer margin: 445. It sits in the same margin column as the running header, lower down. The facing leaf carries 444 and the next recorded leaf in this fascicle, 三日月藩, carries 447.
丁數四百四十五
